fusions.name: Measured Thrust
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 3 tiles. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Eightfold Kata
fusions.desc: Cuts in a full circle and deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Textbook Parry
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 35% of the damage you take is turned back on whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Corrected Mid-Swing
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
